## About
> Smith Ribbon is a professional OEM/ODM ribbon and bow manufacturer based in Xiamen, Fujian, China. Serving global brands, retailers, and packaging distributors since 2004. 50+ countries export. 1000+ active clients including Walmart, Target, L'Oréal, Dollar General.

## Key Product Lines
- Satin ribbon (single face / double face)
- Grosgrain ribbon
- Organza ribbon
- Velvet ribbon
- Polyester / PP / RPET ribbon
- Pre-tied bows, gift bows, hair bows
- Custom printed ribbon (logo, pattern, brand)
- Christmas & festive decoration ribbon
